data.short_description: N/A

data.status: certificate of occupancy remains under review
data.short_description: Restaurateur Abraham Valenzuela is planning Chukis Burgers at 5865 Poplar Avenue, near his Chukis Tacos. The certificate of occupancy lists the use as a restaurant with sandwiches and burgers and was still under review as of October 29. No opening timeline is available.

data.event_date: early December, possibly the first week of the month
data.status: preparing to open; in its build-out phase
data.short_description: Patchwork Craft Lounge is an arts and crafts lounge where guests reserve time slots to create mixed-media pieces on pre-stenciled canvases. Owner Betsy Lopez-Riley said the space is in build-out and she hopes to open in early December. It will initially run by reservation only, Wednesday through Sunday, 4 p.m. to 10 p.m.

data.status: in the works; no opening date has been announced
data.short_description: The Balboa is a new bar and restaurant planned in the Pearl District by Kurt Huffman of ChefStable. It has applied for a full on-premises liquor license and plans to open daily from noon to 2:30 a.m. with 75 indoor seats and 16 patio seats.

Papa Murphy's is opening in the former Subway space in the Sunriver Business Park. The shop will be run by franchisees Joshua and Samantha Kimzey as their first Papa Murphy's. Construction and new signage have been going up, and a "Hiring Soon" flyer was shared.

data.status: hoping to get the kiosk fully open by March
data.short_description: The Emerald Cup owners are building a permanent kiosk at The Shops at Church 103. The coffee cart operates at the church through the holidays, and the team hopes to open the kiosk fully by March. Food items will be added once the kiosk is open.
Emerald Social is a second concept from the Emerald Cup team planned for Mokena. The article says it has not yet opened.

data.location: Michigan Central Station, 2001 15th St Suite 101, Detroit, MI 48216
data.short_description: The NoMad hotel brand is opening NoMad Detroit at Michigan Central Station, with reporting calling for a 2027 opening. Sydell Group and Hilton are behind the project. The station's historic restaurant and carriage house will become NoMad dining and bar concepts.

data.status: planned; an opening date has not yet been set
data.short_description: Slapz Deli is a planned sandwich concept in Clermont, based on a state-level filing initially made in October 2024. The listed owners are Subra and Jasim Deeb. Guests can expect loaded deli sandwiches, although no menu has been released.

data.status: preparing to open; signage read "Coming soon."
data.short_description: Bondi Sushi is preparing to open a new Upper East Side location near E. 82nd St. No official opening date has been announced. Hours will likely run from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.

data.location: 1701 S University Dr #103, Fort Worth, TX 76107
data.footage_size: about 3,262 square feet, including a 733-square-foot patio
data.short_description: Mendocino Farms is preparing its first Fort Worth and Tarrant County restaurant at Westbend near TCU. A roughly $650,000 buildout is planned to start in December 2026, with construction scheduled to wrap up in March 2027.
Maman, the New York-based bakery and café, is expected to open in Westbend's new phase. Its target is March 2027.

data.location: 1312 Celebrity Cir, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577 (Broadway at the Beach)
data.status: Coming Soon; working toward a 2027 opening
data.short_description: Bubba Gump Shrimp Co. is opening a new location at Broadway at the Beach in Myrtle Beach. It will take over the space formerly occupied by Landry's Seafood House and is working toward a 2027 opening.

data.location: 140 Sugar Belle Drive, Suite A, Winter Garden, FL 34787 (Flamingo Crossings Town Center)
data.status: working on a new location; exact opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Wings & Rings submitted documents to the Florida DBPR for a new Winter Garden restaurant in Flamingo Crossings Town Center. The project is led by Alvaro Diez of Pieocentral LLC. The location adds to the brand's existing locations in Fort Myers, North Port and Port Charlotte.

data.status: expected to reopen as Pacchioni's by early December
data.short_description: Pacchioni's is opening its first brick-and-mortar location in College Park in the former Pizza Bruno space. Founder Daniel Pacchioni is opening it with partners Yeosh Bendayan and Jon Ruhff. An exact opening date has not been announced.
Pizza Bruno will close after November 7, and its space will become Pacchioni's. Owner Bruno Zacchini selected the new group and will provide mentorship.

data.status: preparing to open; signed a lease
data.short_description: Stiles Switch BBQ signed a lease for the former Z'Tejas space in Kyle and can take over the property in January 2027. Renovations of about $500,000 are targeted for completion in mid-February 2027. An opening date has not been announced.
The Z'Tejas in Kyle closed in June 2025. Its former space has been leased to Stiles Switch BBQ.

Whit's Frozen Custard is opening its first Miami location in Downtown Dadeland. The shop will be operated by Eleven O1, L.P., led by Adam Bengharsa. The group plans about 10 South Florida locations over the next five to six years.

data.location: Doral Square, 8700 NW 36th Street, Doral, FL
data.short_description: Sicilian Oven is opening a Doral location on the ground floor of Doral Square with a large wraparound patio. It is one of three new South Florida leases announced in a JLL press release.

data.footage_size: approximately 4,663 square feet, plus patio space
data.short_description: Sicilian Oven will open in Kendall within an open-air shopping center owned by Kimco Realty. The opening is expected in the first quarter of 2028.

data.location: 1800 N. Congress Avenue, Boynton Beach, FL
data.short_description: Sicilian Oven will open its first Boynton Beach location on the ground floor of a mixed-use property. The opening is expected in the second or third quarter of 2027.

data.status: still being reported as a planned development; no official opening date has been announced
data.short_description: The Lexington Ledger reports that a new Whataburger will open at 2550 Augusta Highway in the Victory Village area. No official opening date has been announced.

data.location: 407 West Street inside Chelsea Market, Manhattan (scraper: 407 W 15th St, New York, NY 10011)
data.short_description: The Stand West is a new comedy club and restaurant inside Chelsea Market, extending The Stand, which was founded in 2012. It seats 150–170 guests for regular shows and up to 244 for private events. Food comes from Chelsea Market partners, led initially by N'Between Bar.

data.status: planning; application listed as in process
data.short_description: 100 Montaditos is planning a Hollywood restaurant under 100M Hollywood LLC, according to DBPR records. As of October 29, 2026, the application was in process under plan review. No construction schedule or opening date is confirmed.
ZipSauce will soon open a restaurant in Clinton Township, targeting around Nov. 23, according to CEO Michael Esshaki. The chain already operates in Shelby Township, Port Huron and Westland.
CEO Michael Esshaki said the team is also working on a location on 10 Mile in Warren. It is set to open sometime next month.

Sacramento dive bar Firefly Lounge has permanently closed after nearly a decade, serving its last customers on November 3. Owner Connie Hale-Schuessler, who bought the bar in 2017, announced the closure on social media without giving an official reason.
Coastal Concepts Hospitality is working on a new pizza restaurant called Americana Detroit Style Pizza in Surfside Beach. The specific site has not been revealed.

data.location: Broadway at the Beach, Myrtle Beach
data.short_description: Coastal Concepts Hospitality plans to launch Southern Social at Myrtle Beach's Broadway at the Beach development. It is one of two new restaurants planned there by the group.

data.location: Broadway at the Beach, Myrtle Beach
data.short_description: Coastal Concepts Hospitality plans to launch Rustic & Rye at Myrtle Beach's Broadway at the Beach development. It is the second of two restaurants planned there by the group.
Ibérico, a Spanish and Portuguese wine and tapas bar, is opening in Fort Greene on November 5. It was founded by Chef Felipe Donnelly and Wine Director Tamy Rofe, the couple behind Colonia Verde.

data.location: 15080 Beltway Drive, Addison, TX 75001 (Addison Park Place)
data.short_description: A TDLR filing registered October 26, 2026 lists a tenant improvement for Love Life (and Pizza) in Addison, estimated at $150,000. Construction is scheduled from November 2, 2026 to February 1, 2027, but no public opening date has been confirmed.
SixtyFour-Wine Bar & Kitchen in downtown Naperville is closing after 10 years. It will serve its final meal on Wednesday, November 25, according to a social media announcement.
The restaurant team announced the closure of SixtyFour-Reserve Room in downtown Naperville. It was announced together with the closure of SixtyFour-Wine Bar & Kitchen.
Amorino Gelato is opening its newest location in the Medley development in Johns Creek on November 6. It is the brand's third Georgia location, and the first 1,000 guests will get a free gelato cone.
Germantown seafood restaurant Henrietta Red will permanently close in April 2027 after a decade. Chef-owner Julia Sullivan said the lease is ending and the property has been listed for sale.

Terry Black's Barbecue will open its first San Antonio location near the Pearl District on November 17, 2026. The restaurant will seat about 200 guests, employ 120 people, and be the brand's eighth location.
Pinstripes is returning to Orlando under new ownership, reopening on November 11 at Vineland Pointe. The fully renovated venue keeps its 16 bowling lanes and adds new games and patio activities.

data.footage_size: nearly 7,000 square feet of outdoor space
data.short_description: Muchacho is scheduled to open its third location in the former Revival space in Downtown Decatur on Nov. 6. Opening events run November 6 to 8 at the renovated 1940 Craftsman bungalow.

data.event_date: November; grand opening celebration in December
data.short_description: Slime Co. is opening its first Arizona location at Chandler Fashion Center this November. A grand opening celebration is planned for December, with details to be announced.
A second Valley location of Slime Co. at Arrowhead Towne Center in Glendale is slated to open later this year.
Urijah Faber's Ultimate Fitness is bringing a new gym to Roseville, with classes held at a temporary spot two doors down. No finish date has been set for the permanent space's build-out.
A new Great Clips salon will soon open in San Antonio. What Now confirmed the opening with a franchisee representative, and further details are pending.

The Salty Paws Houma LA truck is preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar storefront on Magazine Street. Renovations and permitting are underway, and the franchisee expects to set an opening date ahead of the holiday shopping season.

data.event_date: early next year; grand opening tentatively planned to coincide with Mardi Gras
data.short_description: Artist Katherin Freeman is converting a former service station into a studio, retail space, and event center. Construction is projected to finish by mid-December, with a grand opening tentatively planned around Mardi Gras.
KidsUnited will open a Walpole facility on November 20, with a free open house on November 7. Free trial classes will be offered on grand opening day.
KidsUnited will open a second new location in Woburn on December 4. A presale runs through December 2 and includes a complimentary Player Pack.
The article references an upcoming KidsUnited location in Pembroke. No further details are given.
Five Below will open a new store on the Upper East Side, its sixth in Manhattan. Grand opening festivities are planned throughout the weekend.

Beacon-based general store Solstad House is preparing to open its second location in NoLita in time for the holiday shopping season. The shop will keep the brand's curated selection with a slightly edgier aesthetic.

data.footage_size: nearly 10,000 square feet of indoor fun
data.short_description: Shredder Ski is bringing an indoor ski and snowboard school to Naperville's Block 59. The owner has no opening date yet because it depends on the build-out.

data.store_name: We Rock the Spectrum – North Austin
data.location: 6001 W. Parmer Lane, Suite 430, Austin, TX 78727
data.event_date: Construction start November 3, 2025; estimated completion February 4, 2026
data.short_description: We Rock the Spectrum – North Austin plans a $219,518 renovation at McNeil Crossing, according to TDLR records. Work includes HVAC replacements, new flooring, three offices, and electrical improvements.
